osm_building_height.rule: height tag, else building:levels x 2.9 m

road_width.rule: width tag, else lanes x 3.5 m, else LTA class default

fvc.note: Only 2 of 9 cells reached a usable SCL-masked fraction; the other 7 are empty.

albedo.note: Only 2 of 9 cells reached a usable SCL-masked fraction; the other 7 are empty.

pm25_ugm3.note: CAMS ~11 km model field, 24 h mean in Asia/Singapore local time; not an observation. NEA regional values carry no monitor coordinates.

no2_ugm3.note: CAMS ~11 km model field, 24 h mean

lst_day_c.reason: MODIS needs Earthdata credentials; POWER TS substituted
lst_day_c.note: NASA POWER TS, 0.5x0.625 deg (~55 km) grid point, daily mean with no day/night split; uniform across the 3x3 grid

lst_night_c.reason: no night split in POWER TS; MODIS needs Earthdata credentials

energy_kwh_m2_day.reason: no credential-free building-energy field for Singapore
energy_kwh_m2_day.note: Stewart & Oke (2012) Table 4 Q_F midpoint, W/m2 of ground area x 86400/3.6e6; total anthropogenic heat, not building-only EUI

tree_count_plantable.rule: 0.5 x WorldCover grass x cell area / 115 m2

building_year_non_hdb.rule: OSM start_date where tagged, else empty

notes: data.gov.sg calls are spaced by a few seconds.
Sentinel-2 scene is the least-cloudy 2023 acquisition under 30% cloud; SCL classes 4,5,6 retained.
OSM building ways whose centroid falls inside an HDB block are dropped.
LST, energy, and air quality are proxies, not observations; see baseline_provenance.csv.
